title: I'm a solo dev from Brazil making a scrap-mech game with AI tools. Here's the first boss: the Saci Mecha
author: CarraraCapybara
selftext:
Boiadeiro-01 is a third-person mech game set on a ruined Brazilian farm. You pilot a junk mech built from a tractor, and the first boss is the Saci, a one-legged trickster from Brazilian folklore, rebuilt as a 13 m scrap colossus that rolls around on a single tire.



Every attack is telegraphed and dodgeable: jump the mud wave, sidestep the tire, land before the windstorm blows out your jets. Danger arrows on the ground show where off-screen attacks come from.



 I direct, test and tune everything on a weak laptop (i3 + Intel UHD), so it runs at 60 FPS on low-end PCs.



Free demo + full version on itch: [https://brenobertucci.itch.io/boiadeiro-01](https://brenobertucci.itch.io/boiadeiro-01)



Feedback on the boss fight is very welcome!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/CarraraCapybara could you please add details on how AI was used to make this? Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion with nothing to discuss otherwise. If you don't update, this post may be removed.
